subject: Security exhibit redlines & evidence handoff — order form coordination
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acerapartners.com>, security@acerapartners.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit redlines & evidence handoff — order form coordination

Hi Priya / Acera security team —

Thanks again for the helpful redline. We're close on the MSA/order form but want to align on the security exhibit (audit + pen test) details before legal walks the document back to procurement. High-level asks we want to resolve in this thread:

- Inspection / audit rights (Section 7): proposed language to preserve bounded inspection for SOC 2 / pen test while avoiding tenant-level forensic access.
- Notice windows & sampling bands: we want a predictable notice window so ops can schedule.
- Evidence cadence: what artifacts Acera needs on an ongoing basis (SOC 2 report + supporting attestations, pen test summary, configuration screenshots, logs sampling).
- Pen test logistics: staging carveouts, timing, and whether Acera's third party can run a limited pen test vs. providing our pen test report.

I've attached a short redline-summary-security-exhibit.docx that maps each clause to a proposed response and an evidence owner. Proposed compromises (to speed procurement):

1) Notice: 45 days for inspection requests (compromise between your 60d ask and our standard 30d).
2) Sampling: agree to sample-based inspection (tenant-level excluded) with a 24-hour live view limited to a single agreed environment.
3) Pen test: accept third-party pen tests if run against our staging environment during a mutually-agreed window; otherwise we will provide our latest pen test report (within 12 months).
4) Evidence cadence: quarterly evidence bundle (SOC 2 artifacts + configuration snapshots) and ad-hoc critical-item follow-up within 7 business days.

Next steps: can your legal/security confirm whether 45-day notice + sample-only inspection is acceptable? If yes, we'll produce a consolidated redline and schedule a triage call with your security lead.

Thanks —
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: redline-summary-security-exhibit.docx, evidence-matrix-compact.xlsx

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acerapartners.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acera Health Security <security@acerapartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Sep 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines & evidence handoff — order form coordination

Rohan —

Appreciate the clear mapping. We've had a quick read with procurement + security. A few items from our side (summary, see attached Acera_redline_v2.docx for in-line edits):

- Notice: Procurement prefers 60 days for scheduled inspections (internal policy). Is there any flex to move to 60d? If not, we want to lock in 45d with a maximum of 2 ad-hoc inspections per year.
- Tenant isolation: we need to preserve the right to request targeted collection (metadata + sample logs) for incidents; full tenant snapshot remains off-limits unless incident-driven and with subpoena/substantial cause.
- Pen test scope: our security team asks that third-party pen tests be allowed only after coordination with your security ops and that Acera gets an executive summary and remediation timeline (30 days) for critical findings. We also want to request a short attestation that KMS keys are accessible to our environment (if we request key escrow for specific integrations).
- Evidence retention: we require audit evidence to be maintained for 12 months and made available on request in the quarterly bundle (we'll accept redacted artifacts when necessary).

Would your legal and security operations team be OK with: 60d notice OR 45d + 2 ad-hoc inspections; pen-test coordination with 30d remediation SLA for critical items; evidence retained for 12 months?

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call with your security ops and Laura to go clause-by-clause.

Best,
Priya Shah
Sr. Contracts Counsel — Acera Health
priya.shah@acerapartners.com

Attachment: Acera_redline_v2.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acerapartners.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines & evidence handoff — order form coordination

Thanks Priya — good summary. Quick internal thoughts from Legal/ProdSec to try and bridge: 

- Notice: we can accept 60 days only if we get an exception for one off-shift (limited) access for incident triage (i.e., emergency inspections with 48h notice and post-hoc documentation). Alternative: accept 45d notice + cap of 2 ad-hoc inspections (same as your ask) — I think that lands in the same operational ballpark.
- Tenant isolation / targeted collection: we will commit to targeted metadata/log samples for incident investigations provided there is a written justification and an agreed scope; forensic-level tenant dumps require executive escalation and signed NDA amendment.
- Pen test: acceptable to allow Acera's vendor to run tests against our staging environment; we need a signed scope and a runbook. We can provide our most recent pen test report (within 12 months). For remediation, we will provide a summary and a remediation plan — target 30 calendar days for critical items where feasible.
- Evidence cadence: suggest the following operational pattern to avoid repeated ad-hoc asks: quarterly evidence bundle (SOC 2 core report + control narrative excerpt, system configuration snapshot, pen test executive summary when available) + on-demand critical follow-up within 7 business days. Marissa will own the quarterly bundle; Karthik will own the staging carveout and runbook.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Marissa Cole: produce a draft "evidence bundle template" (sec-exhibit-gap-log.xlsx) by 2025-09-08.
- Karthik Iyer: draft a staging carveout + vendor runbook for pen tests by 2025-09-12.
- Laura Bennett: consolidate legal compromise language for Section 7 and circulate redline by 2025-09-09.
- Rohan: schedule a 30-minute triage with Acera security for next week to review technical runbook.

If that set of compromises is acceptable to Acera, Laura will circulate a consolidated redline for countersign. Priya — would you confirm whether you prefer 60d or the 45d + 2 ad-hoc language (we'll prepare both inline so procurement can pick)?

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines & evidence handoff — order form coordination

Priya / team —

Thanks — the compromise approach Laura outlined is acceptable to Redwood. To keep momentum we produced a gap-log and consolidated language (attached sec-exhibit-gap-log.xlsx). Key confirmations:

- We will proceed with the 45-day notice + maximum 2 ad-hoc inspections (Acera can choose to require 60d but that will go to procurement for exception).
- Targeted metadata/log sampling for incidents is allowed with written justification; full tenant dumps require exec escalation.
- Pen tests: Acera vendor may run tests against agreed staging windows using Karthik's runbook. We will provide pen test exec summary and remediation plan for critical items (target 30 days).
- Evidence cadence: Marissa will send the first quarterly evidence bundle on 2025-09-22.

Can we lock a 30-minute triage call on 2025-09-10 at 10:00 PT to finalize the runbook and agree on the initial bundle contents? I'll send an invite.

Thanks —
Rohan
